codelines.evidence: The codeline initializes the Contentstack Delivery SDK in src/services/contentstack.ts at line 91: `export const Stack = contentstack.Stack(options)`. The `options` object (lines 71–89) includes api_key, delivery_token, environment, branch, and fetchOptions, but contains NO `live_preview` configuration — no preview_token, no enable flag, no preview host. The `@contentstack/live-preview-utils` package is present in node_modules but NOT declared in package.json (installed_undeclared), meaning it cannot be relied upon in the build. A codebase-wide search for `live_preview`, `live-preview-utils`, `onEntryChange`, `preview_token`, and `ContentstackLivePreview` returned zero source matches (only orchestration log hits). Content is consumed via a `useContent` hook (src/hooks/useContent.ts) backed by `ContentstackContext` (React context), and the `ContentstackFactory` class in contentstack.ts wraps the Stack for all query/entry operations (getEntry, getSingleEntry, etc.). This is a Next.js app with `contentstack` and `@contentstack/utils` in its manifest — exactly the stack the linked Contentstack docs target — but no live preview wiring exists yet.

recommendedInvestigators.focus: Wire Contentstack Live Preview into the existing Stack initialization and content delivery pipeline. Specifically: (1) Add `@contentstack/live-preview-utils` to package.json dependencies — it is currently installed but undeclared. (2) Add `live_preview` config (preview_token, enable, host) to the `options` object in src/services/contentstack.ts around line 71–89. (3) Initialize `ContentstackLivePreview.init()` with the Stack SDK, considering the app's SSR vs CSR rendering strategy — the docs describe CSR App Router setup, but this codeline uses React Context (ContentstackContext) for content distribution, so the `onEntryChange` callback must be wired to refresh that context, not individual page components. (4) Determine how preview tokens and environment variables will be managed (the codeline already reads CONTENTSTACK_BRANCH, API_KEY, DELIVERY_TOKEN from process.env). (5) Investigate whether custom preview URLs are needed for this site's routing structure (nested routes, locale-based paths).
